Please note there is no insurance coverage on USPS Shipments and no refunds for lost packages (except if the item is shipped Priority Mail, then insurance is covered by USPS up to $50).
(Insurance
is not
covered by Goodwill, check USPS website for insurance information)
All Fed Ex deliveries are insured and covered for loss. Items $100 or over will require a signature.
Fed Ex cannot deliver to PO boxes
.
If you do not receive your item or it is damaged please contact us, with pictures of the damage done to the item(s) and we will place the claim with the shipper.
PLEASE DO NOT PLACE THE CLAIM YOURSELF.
Combined shipping occurs automatically when items are paid for at the same time and do not exceed
20 pounds
.  However they must have been listed as combinable.

description:
You are purchasing a "Sealed Blank CD Rom Mixed Lot Recordable Media Discs Cds" in "Used" condition.
Sealed Blank CD Rom Mixed Lot Recordable Media Discs Cds. all packs sealed. Untested, new. See photos. over 100 total
Selling a mixed lot of recordable CD-R discs on a spindle – perfect for anyone who still loves burning custom music mixes, backing up files, or archiving old projects. This bundle includes a 50-pack Office Depot spindle labeled 700MB/80 min CD-R plus additional loose discs including Pengo 650MB/74min high-speed CD-R and a purple PNY CD-R. These discs are great for: - Creating custom audio CDs for car or home stereo - Storing photos and important documents - Backing up older computers and media collections - Crafting retro tech projects or art pieces Condition is used with visible scuffs and light scratches on many discs, so this lot is ideal for non-critical use, experimentation, or anyone who needs a bunch of discs at a low cost. Keywords: cd-r lot, recordable cd discs, 700mb cd-r, 650mb cd-r, blank cds, office depot cd-r, pny cd-r, pengo cd-r, data backup discs, music burning discs
Condition Notes:
Mixed lot of CD-R discs on a spindle with several different label designs and brands visible. Many discs show surface scuffs and light scratches on the reflective side. Some discs have colored recording surfaces and decorative edge patterns. Spindle packaging shows creasing and wear to the plastic wrap and paper label but remains intact. No obvious cracks or chips are visible on the discs or spindle.
Aspects:
MPN: 408-461
Type: CD-R Recordable Discs
Brand: various
Capacity: 700MB and 650MB mixed
Features: 700MB/80 min (Office Depot spindle) CD-Recordable
Unit Type: Discs
Item Weight: 6
Unit Quantity: Approximately 50 discs
Packaging Type: Spindle
Maximum Write Speed: 12x (Pengo discs)

description:
Natural Crystal and Geode Collection
Mixed Mineral Specimens and Polished Stones
Approximately 60 Items, Mixed Era
This comprehensive collection features a diverse array of natural geological specimens, highlighted by two significant geode slabs. The assortment includes raw geodes, polished specimens, and carved forms, making it an ideal starter set for a collector. The variety of colors and crystalline structures showcases the natural beauty of various mineral groups.
ITEMS INCLUDED:
1.
Large Amethyst Slab
- Purple crystal structure with natural rind
2.
Large Agate Slice
- Translucent with druzy pockets
3.
Red Jasper Pyramid
- Polished geometric form
4.
Mini Geodes (Bulk)
- Numerous cracked-open specimens
5.
Polished Gemstones
- Snowflake obsidian, green aventurine, and jaspers
6.
Raw Minerals
- Pyrite and smoky quartz chunks
Condition:
Good overall condition. Geodes are naturally fractured to reveal interiors. Slabs are structurally sound and stable. Polished pieces show smooth finishes with no significant chips. Minor surface dust present from natural storage.
Warehouse Location: Cleveland
Due to our lighting, white glare lines may appear on items - This is NOT damage
If you have any questions regarding the quality or authenticity of this item or general questions regarding and item, please click Contact Seller on the item page and send us a message. We are available to answer your questions Monday through Friday, 8 am - 3:00 pm, EST.
* For combined shipping policy see the shipping tab.
Some items may contain unseen flaws not noted in the description.
See Photos. Items sold as-is.

description:
Natural Specimen
Clear Quartz Crystal Collection
Natural and Polished Quartz Mineral
3.5" x 3.5" x 1.5" (Lot Dimensions)
Unsigned
This four-piece mineral lot features a selection of clear quartz specimens demonstrating various crystal habits and lapidary finishes. The collection includes a sharply defined double-terminated point, a large natural terminated crystal with complex internal structure, a polished point showcasing vibrant rainbow iris inclusions, and a textured rough-hewn point. These pieces illustrate the high clarity and characteristic trigonal crystal system of quartz, presenting a range of textures from pristine polished facets to raw, natural terminations.
Features one double-terminated crystal and one specimen with visible rainbow inclusions
Diverse mix of natural formations and polished geometric points
Specimens range from approximately 2 to 3 inches in individual length
Total lot weight of 1 pound provides substantial presence for display or study
Condition:
Good condition overall with natural internal fractures and inclusions consistent with mineral specimens. A few small chips and detached shards are present as noted in the detail photographs. The surfaces vary between high-gloss polish and natural matte textures.

shipping.policy:
Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

.
Once payment has cleared, orders are generally processed within 5 business days, not including weekends or holidays.
Goodwill Industries of the Inland Northwest will not be held liable for lost or stolen packages if they are marked
delivered
within the tracking details. It is the responsibility of the customer to contact the shipping carrier to inquire about the claims process for reimbursement. We are happy to provide the necessary paperwork to facilitate this process.
Purchased items will be shipped as specified within the order. We are unable to reroute packages once processed. Please ensure any address changes are made prior to payment during the checkout process. Per FedEx policies, we cannot accept P.O. boxes, please provide us with a physical address.
Buyers may also arrange their own third-party shipping service for pick-up only items. However, the carrier must assume all responsibility for the item and must be able to retrieve, pack, and ship. Please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry.
Combined shipping
Due to automation, items can only be combined prior to payment being received. Eligible items must meet the following criteria:
The items are from the same Goodwill location.
The items close within the same week.
You have not already paid for any of the items.
The combined weight does not exceed 20 pounds.
Items are not already in a fixed-price, flat-rate shipping box.
Items can't be purchased via buy-it-now or with 1 cent shipping.
You will be automatically prompted to combine all available items during checkout. If the site does not, please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry; some exceptions may be made.
